LESSON: ASIKILIZE KISA KIKISIMULIWA.

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa.

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa.. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. explain what asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. from Kenya
3. practise asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. in clear steps
4. apply asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. in one real-life situation this week

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: ASIKILIZE KISA KIKISIMULIWA.
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. helps you succeed in KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

KEY FACTS: ASIKILIZE KISA KIKISIMULIWA.
Study asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa.”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. from Kenya. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. from Kenya.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuzungumza: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. in clear steps. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. in clear steps.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuandika: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. in one real-life situation this week.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa.”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa.”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain what asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa.. (skill: give 3 correct examples of asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. from Kenya)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa.. (skill: practise asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. in clear steps)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa.”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: apply asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. in one real-life situation this week)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa.: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa.?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
